transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… I’ve just been feeling like I’ve messed everything up. Work, my apartment… all of it. Like I’m falling behind and it’s my fault, and whatever happens next, I probably deserve it.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About… a little over a year, I guess. Maybe a year and two months. It started after a pipe burst and I had to move into a smaller apartment, and my routines just kind of fell apart.
Do you still find pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?

Not really. Most days I wake up with this… heavy, flat feeling. I’ll try putting on a record, or cooking something, or messing with electronics like I used to, but it just doesn’t really reach me anymore.
Have you ever thought that life wasn't worth living or had thoughts about ending your life?
Sometimes, yeah. I don’t have a plan to hurt myself or anything… but I do catch myself thinking it’d be easier if I just didn’t wake up. Like nobody would have to deal with me anymore.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or find pleasure in, even if it's just a little bit?

Maybe a little, but… not much. I’ll put on a record or try cooking, or mess with some electronics, and it’s like I remember those things used to help. They just don’t really get through the heaviness most days.
Do you have days where you feel a little better and can somewhat enjoy things, or is it pretty consistent?

It’s pretty consistent, I guess. Most days I wake up with that same flat, heavy sadness. Sometimes I try the usual things—music, cooking, messing with electronics—but… it doesn’t really reset me like it used to.
Are there any days where you feel even slightly better than others?
Maybe… a little, here and there. But most days I wake up with the same flat, heavy feeling. The stuff that used to help—music, cooking, tinkering with things—it just doesn’t really reach me anymore.
Do you ever have days where you can enjoy things without that heavy feeling?
Not really. I mean… I can do things, like put on a record or cook something, but most days that heavy feeling is still there. It doesn’t really lift.
Are your feelings of sadness usually present for most of the day?

Yeah… most of the day, most days. I usually wake up with it already there—that flat, heavy sadness—and it just kind of stays. Even if I put on music or cook or mess with electronics, it doesn’t really reach me like it used to.
Have you had periods of significant depression like this before in your life?
I don’t really know. I’ve had rough times before, sure, but… I don’t think it was like this. Or I just didn’t pay that much attention to it then.
Have you ever felt this low before, or is this the first time you've experienced such persistent sadness?

I don’t think I’ve felt it quite like this before. Most days I wake up already feeling… flat, heavy. The stuff that used to help—music, cooking, messing with electronics—just doesn’t really get through anymore.
Have you had more than one period in your life where you felt this level of sadness?

I’m not sure it’s been more than one, no. This feels… different. Most days now I wake up with that flat, heavy sadness already there, and the things that used to kind of reset me—music, cooking, tinkering—don’t really touch it.
Have you experienced a period of significant depression like this before that lasted for a while and then got better on its own or with treatment?
I can’t really point to one, no. I’ve had bad stretches, but not something I’d clearly say lasted like this and then lifted with treatment or anything.
Have you had an episode of depression like this one before that went away, either on its own or with help?
Not really. I mean, I’ve had rough patches, but I don’t remember anything like this that clearly came and went.
Have you had any periods in your life where you felt similarly depressed, but the feelings of sadness went away for a while before coming back?
I don’t think so. Not in a clear way. I’ve had low times, but I can’t really say it went away and then came back like this.
Have you had any other episodes of depression in your life before this one started?
No… I don’t think so. I’ve had times where I felt down, but nothing I’d call a separate episode before this.
Have you had any episodes of depression before this one that a doctor or therapist helped you with?
No, I haven’t had a doctor or therapist help me with depression before this. Not before now.
Have you ever been diagnosed with depression by a healthcare professional before this episode?
No. Not before this… nobody had diagnosed me with that.
Have you had any periods in your life where you felt better for a while after feeling as sad as you do now?
Not really… it’s been pretty steady. Maybe about a year and a couple months now, since that pipe burst and I had to move into the smaller apartment. Things just kind of fell apart after that.
Have you had more than one episode of depression in your life?

No… I don’t think more than one. It’s just been this one stretch, about a year and two months, since the pipe burst and I had to move into that smaller place. My routines kind of fell apart after that.
